items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: “The Latin American Symphonette” by Morton Gould. And it was a duet between alto sax and oboe, my oboe teacher. That’s 1951. And I never forgot it.
